about: Labelled training examples for the embedding intent classifier. NOT an evaluation set -- the classifier is fitted on these, so its accuracy here is reported for reference and never gated. Grown from 64 examples to 118 because the classifier's weakest measured set was intent_queries at 0.7083, and 64 examples across three classes is thin for k-nearest-neighbour: with k=5 a single unusual phrasing has no near neighbour of its own class to find. The 54 added examples were written without reading any evaluation set, deliberately in registers the original 64 did not cover (bare noun phrases, a stated reason with the request implicit, policy questions about non-leave topics), and the fourth held-out set was created before any of them existed. eval_intent.js measures the nearest-neighbour similarity between every evaluation query and this file and fails the build above 0.92, so growth here cannot quietly become leakage.
